definition: Net income attributable to the parent's shareholders: after the non-controlling (minority) interests' share, including discontinued operations.
note: Backlog #157: the textbook net margin's numerator (CFA Level I, Financial Analysis Techniques; IAS 1.81B 'attributable to owners of the parent'). Not ProfitLoss, which under US GAAP is consolidated net income including non-controlling interests. Reported figures only, never read by a valuation.
